# Qwen3.8-Flash-Next abliterated UD-IQ4_XS (RunPod cache)

Single-model cache for a RunPod Serverless llama.cpp endpoint; RunPod Cached Models download a whole repository, and
the source repository holds every quantization. The files are unchanged copies of
[huihui-ai/Huihui-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-abliterated-v2-GGUF](https://huggingface.co/huihui-ai/Huihui-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-abliterated-v2-GGUF):
the three `unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS` shards and `mmproj-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-BF16.gguf`. Base model:
[Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next), under the Qwen Community License 1.0
(`LICENSE`, copied unchanged from the base repository).
